name: X-Man Tornado V4 M 3x3 (Flagship)
description: This is the X-Man Tornado V4 M 3x3 (Flagship). This puzzle is a successor to the Tornado V3 which has set many world records over the last few years. This one has a ball-core, and an updated adjustment system that allows you to adjust the magnet strength in an entire corner with just a single twist! This version has a matte finish and a spring tensioning system. Get yours today!
